definitions.explanation: Changing from one mode of transportation to another, or from one flight/train to another, during a journey.

examples.japanese: シンガポールで{乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎがある。
{乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ{時間|じかん}は2{時間|じかん}です。
examples.english: The layover time is two hours.

examples.japanese: {乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎに{失敗|しっぱい}して、{次|つぎ}の{便|びん}を{待|ま}つことになった。
examples.english: I missed my connection and had to wait for the next flight.

notes:
Used for both air travel (connecting flights) and ground transportation (transferring trains or buses).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ{便|びん} (connecting flight)
- {乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ{時間|じかん} (layover/transfer time)
- {乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ{客|きゃく} (transit passenger)
- {乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎをする (to make a transfer)

RELATED TERMS:
- {乗|の}り{換|か}え: changing trains (often used for trains within a city)
- {直行便|ちょっこうびん}: direct flight
- {経由|けいゆ}: via, by way of
